Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance reaches or exceeds $85,000 USDT at any point on or before September 30, 2026, 23:59:59 UTC.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance does not reach or exceed $85,000 USDT at any point on or before September 30, 2026, 23:59:59 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance touches or exceeds $85,000 USDT at any traded price (including intraday highs) recorded up to and including September 30, 2026, 23:59:59 UTC.
